ai_summary.summary: The CRM is generally stable with most modules visible and no critical data issues. However, several areas show redundancy and inefficiency, particularly in custom fields and module layouts.
critical: 11 global picklists are orphaned and not used by any field — these should be removed immediately to avoid data inconsistencies and maintenance overhead.
Deal module has 4 layouts and 88 custom fields — this is a significant configuration burden and may affect performance and user experience.
warnings: Lead module has 93 custom fields — this is high and may indicate redundancy; review for unnecessary or duplicated fields.
Contact module has 59 custom fields — excessive customisation may lead to data quality issues and training challenges.
Account module has 70 custom fields — similar to leads and contacts, this requires audit for relevance and necessity.
Module layouts are misaligned: Campaign has 5 layouts, Deals has 4 — this may cause confusion and inefficiency.
positives: No unused tags detected — tag usage is clean and efficient.
All hidden modules are properly marked as user or system hidden — visibility is well-managed.
recommended_actions: Remove the 11 orphaned global picklists immediately to clean up configuration.
Audit and reduce custom fields in Leads, Contacts, Accounts, and Deals to under 30 per module.
Review and standardise module layouts — limit to one primary layout per module where possible.
Investigate single-record or zero-record modules to determine if they are underused.
